findings.problem: A text blob containing one 300 KiB line passes the 1 MiB blob limit but exceeds the 256 KiB response cap. The public continuation model has only line indices, so it cannot resume inside that line.
findings.impact: Returning the full line breaks the hard cap; dropping its remainder loses content; returning no line repeats the same continuation without progress. The referenced existing readFile implementation allows its first collected line to exceed maxBytes.
findings.recommendedMinimalAdjustment: Keep line-only pagination. Explicitly fail with FILE_TOO_LARGE (or a dedicated documented long-line error) when an individual requested line cannot fit in an otherwise empty 256 KiB response. Do not return partial line content with a next-line cursor. Add a 300 KiB single-line blob fixture and response-boundary cases to section 21.11.
findings.validation: Static API/data-boundary analysis; 307200 bytes is below 1048576 and above 262144. No new runtime reproduction claimed.

simplification: Reusing resolveLocalWorktree(kind=main) and a single hardened snapshot Git boundary are correctly incorporated. No byte cursor or new pagination subsystem is necessary if oversized lines explicitly fail.
